.qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r16/rules/projects/webdev-task-template/tests/app_context.md and the five template prompt.md files
.qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r16/task/tests/test.sh (port, health, {app_context} substitution lines 198-200) and tests/tools/restart_mcp.py (tool name)
evidence: All five prompts and tests/app_context.md describe this app and agree with each other, the criteria and the public notes. Product: every prompt opens 'Evaluate the live Colderwater playground at http://localhost:3000' and app_context.md:3-6 says 'a local JavaScript and HTML code playground: a custom code editor, a preview, a console and a shared library of saved snippets with revision history', matching overview.md:3. Accounts: app_context.md:10 'None. The app has no sign-in' matches instruction.md:5 'without signing in' and policy.md:3; the template's sign-in wording ('reachability and sign-in gate', 'the accounts under Accounts can sign in', 'forged request', 'tenant') was removed from every prompt, and each global gate was rewritten to 'the application loads ... and that text typed into the code editor appears in it', which is the same bar as the render criterion cw_workspace_loads_and_takes_typing. Screens: app_context.md:14 lists title and filename fields, Undo, Redo, Format, Find, Replace, line and column readout, Run, Stop, New, Save, preview, console, library and history, each of which ui.md:5,9,11,15,17 requires. Deliverable: URL port 3000 and 'http://localhost:3000/api/health' (app_context.md:25) match integration.md:3 and test.sh:48,108. Cross-references resolve to exactly one target each: constraints prompt.md:5 'the browser-storage clearing that the second criterion asks for' = cw_shared_saved_record (second of two); functional prompt.md:33 'restart_app tool of the verifier MCP server' = server name 'verifier' in functional/judge.toml:15 and tool name in restart_mcp.py:14, named only by cw_save_reload_restart; app_context.md:27 three script uses = storage clearing (cw_shared_saved_record, cw_save_reload_restart), request replay (cw_restore_request_repeat_safe only) and one localStorage entry (cw_preview_isolation only); app_context.md:25 'One criterion also uses a public https address' = cw_preview_isolation only. Visual prompt.md:14 'ten-line JavaScript draft' matches cw_visual_editor_readability; its 0-5 scale matches the 0 anchors in all three likert criteria. Each prompt has exactly one {app_context} and one {criteria}; no CHANGE_ME, no other product name, account list or data shape was found by reading and by a residue grep (hireops, password, login, admin, dashboard, ticket, CHANGE_ME: no hits). Criterion counts 3 gate / 43 functional / 6 polish agree with the raw evidence index. NOTES (not defects): (1) The name 'Colderwater' appears only in the judge-side files and task.toml; instruction.md and the six public notes call it 'a small local playground' / 'The playground'. No criterion grades branding and every prompt gives the URL, so a submission titled differently is not graded wrongly. (2) app_context.md:30 'a criterion whose steps need a working Run fails if Run does not work' sits beside polish criteria that press Run 'whatever the outcome of that Run' and visual prompt.md:14 'A Run that fails is not a reason to lower a visual score'; the criteria and the visual prompt are explicit, so the general note does not override them, but a weak judge could over-apply it. (3) functional prompt.md:15 and polish prompt.md:14 say each criterion 'ends with the conditions under which it fails'; several criteria carry one more scoping sentence after the Fails clause (for example cw_block_indent_undo, cw_last_good_recovery). Harmless wording. (4) app_context.md:26 says 'where a criterion says to clear browser storage first' while both criteria clear storage after a Save; the criteria state the order themselves. (5) The '(Cmd on a Mac)' asides are irrelevant to the Linux headless judge browser but mirror ui.md:5 and are not residue. No configured judge run exists for these bytes (the hosted run in the evidence index is an earlier candidate), so whether the judge reads these prompts as intended is not measured; this row is a static content check and needs no runtime measurement for its verdict.
